name: Pink Bollworm (Pectinophora gossypiella)
symptoms: Rosetted flowers, double seeds inside bolls, premature opening of bolls with stained lint, small holes plugged with excreta.
identification: Small pink caterpillars (10-12 mm) inside squares and bolls; small greyish-brown moths with fringed wings.
biological_control: Release Trichogramma bactrae egg parasitoid @ 60,000/acre. Spray Beauveria bassiana @ 5g/L. Install 8 pheromone traps/acre.
chemical_control: Spray Emamectin Benzoate 5% SG @ 0.5g/L or Chlorantraniliprole 18.5% SC @ 0.3ml/L or Profenofos 50% EC @ 2ml/L.
prevention: Avoid staggered sowings; terminate crop by December; strictly avoid ratoon cotton.

name: Whitefly (Bemisia tabaci)
symptoms: Yellowing and upward curling of leaves, sticky honeydew secretion with black sooty mold growth on leaf surface, transmission of viral diseases (Leaf Curl, YVMV).
identification: Tiny (1 mm) white moth-like insects congregating under leaf undersides, flying up in swarms when shaken.
biological_control: Install 15-20 yellow sticky traps/acre. Spray 5% Neem oil (10,000 ppm) or Verticillium lecanii @ 5g/L.
chemical_control: Spray Diafenthiuron 50% WP @ 1.25g/L or Spiromesifen 22.9% SC @ 1ml/L or Acetamiprid 20% SP @ 0.2g/L.
prevention: Eradicate weed hosts around field borders; plant 2 rows of maize or pearl millet as border windbreaks.

name: Fall Armyworm (Spodoptera frugiperda)
symptoms: Severe skeletonization of leaves, deep ragged feeding holes in whorls, heaps of sawdust-like brown frass inside whorls.
identification: Greenish-brown larvae with inverted 'Y' shaped white mark on head and 4 dark spots arranged in square on 8th abdominal segment.
biological_control: Place sand mixed with lime/ash into whorls. Release egg parasitoids Telenomus remus. Spray Metarhizium anisopliae @ 5g/L.
chemical_control: Spray Chlorantraniliprole 18.5% SC @ 0.4ml/L or Spinetoram 11.7% SC @ 0.5ml/L directed into central leaf whorl with knapsack nozzle.
prevention: Synchronized early community sowing; intercrop with cowpea; deep summer plowing to expose pupae to birds.

name: Aphids (Aphis gossypii / Myzus persicae)
symptoms: Stunted curling tender shoots, honey-dew drops attracting black ants and black sooty mold on upper leaf canopy.
identification: Soft-bodied pear-shaped tiny green, black or yellow insects crowding on tender growing tips and flower buds.
biological_control: Encourage ladybird beetles and hoverflies. Spray soap water (5g/L) or Dashaparni ark. Spray Neem oil (5ml/L).
chemical_control: Spray Imidacloprid 17.8% SL @ 0.3ml/L or Dimethoate 30% EC @ 1.7ml/L or Thiamethoxam 25% WG @ 0.3g/L.
prevention: Avoid excess nitrogen fertilizer which produces overly succulent vegetative shoots.

name: Stem Borer & Leaf Folder
name_te: కాండం తొలుచు పురుగు & ఆకు చుట్టు పురుగు
symptoms: 'Dead heart' in tillering stage (central shoot dries and pulls out easily); 'White earhead' at panicle emergence; folded longitudinal leaf blades with white scraped patches.
causes: Scirpophaga incertulas (Yellow stem borer) and Cnaphalocrocis medinalis larvae.
biological_control: Install 5 pheromone traps/acre. Release Trichogramma japonicum @ 40,000/acre at 30 and 45 days after transplanting.
chemical_control: Apply Cartap Hydrochloride 4% G @ 7.5 kg/acre or spray Chlorantraniliprole 18.5% SC @ 0.3ml/L or Flubendiamide 39.35% SC @ 0.2ml/L.
prevention: Clip seedling tips before transplanting to remove egg masses. Avoid stagnant water level during peak moth emergence.

name: Fruit and Shoot Borer (Leucinodes orbonalis)
name_hi: बैंगन का फल एवं तना छेदक
symptoms: Terminal shoots droop and wither, visible entry bore holes on eggplant fruits plugged with frass, fruit rot.
identification: Pinkish larvae with brown head boring into fruit flesh; white moths with triangular wings having brownish-red spots.
biological_control: Weekly mechanical clipping of withered shoots. Install Lucin-lure pheromone traps @ 12/acre. Spray NSKE 5%.
chemical_control: Spray Emamectin Benzoate 5% SG @ 0.4g/L or Spinosad 45% SC @ 0.3ml/L or Chlorantraniliprole 18.5% SC @ 0.4ml/L.
prevention: Avoid continuous Solanaceous cropping; destroy crop residue immediately after harvesting.

name: Pod Borer / Gram Caterpillar (Helicoverpa armigera)
symptoms: Circular holes on flower buds and pods; caterpillar feeds with body half-entered into the pod; chewed seed grains.
identification: Greenish, brownish or striped stout caterpillar with distinct lateral lines along body; prominent noctuid moth.
biological_control: Erect 15 bird perches/acre. Spray HaNPV (250 LE/acre) with 0.1% jaggery. Spray Bacillus thuringiensis (Bt) @ 2g/L.
chemical_control: Spray Chlorantraniliprole 18.5% SC @ 0.3ml/L or Indoxacarb 14.5% SC @ 0.75ml/L or Flubendiamide 480 SC @ 0.2ml/L.
prevention: Intercropping pulses with coriander or marigold as trap crops; early synchronous sowing.

name: Rhinoceros Beetle & Red Palm Weevil
name_te: కొమ్ము పురుగు మరియు ఎర్ర ముక్కు పురుగు
name_hi: गैंडा भृंग और लाल ताड़ घुन
symptoms: V-shaped clipping cuts on palm fronds; chewed wet fiber extrusion and thick viscous brownish liquid oozing from holes on coconut trunk.
identification: Large black beetle with single horn on head (Rhinoceros beetle); reddish-brown weevil with prominent snout (Red palm weevil).
biological_control: Hook out beetles from crowns using iron rod. Place Rhinolure / Ferrolure pheromone traps. Fill inner leaf axils with sand + neem cake (1:1).
chemical_control: Root feeding of Monocrotophos (10ml + 10ml water) per palm or stem injection of Imidacloprid (for severe weevil infestation in non-bearing/harvested palms).
prevention: Maintain cleanliness around base; avoid wounding palm stems with climbing knives; treat manure pits with Metarhizium to destroy grubs.
